annotations.title: Send a request to CRM Connector

description: Integrations and AI Agents: Use when the person wants something CRM Connector does not offer yet: an integration with a system it does not connect (kind integration), or an AI agent for a system that has none (kind ai_access). Sends the request to CRM Connector's support team by email and returns whether it was sent. Show the person exactly what will be sent and get their confirmation first. Uses their account email when they are signed in; otherwise pass the email they give. Not for a system an AI agent already works in (use plan_ai_agent).

access.description: For AI Agents: read to read records, read_write to also change them.

company.description: The person's company, when they gave it.

connect_with.description: For an integration: the system it should sync with, when the person said so.

details.description: What the person wants to do, in their own words: what should sync, or what the assistant should do in the system.

email.description: The person's email, so CRM Connector can answer. Leave it out when they are signed in.

kind.description: integration for a system to connect, ai_access for AI Agents on a system.

name.description: The person's name, when they gave it.

system.description: The system the request is about, as the person names it.

name: send_request
title: Send a request to CRM Connector
